_说明: viewer3d.html?model=rothschild_estate 的清单（标准档 rothschild_estate.glb + 低档 rothschild_estate_low.glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米）。由 blender/landmarks/rothschild_estate/build.py（共用 blender/landmarks/upper_estates.py）+ blender/landmarks/export_glb.py 生成。视觉样例·请柬：悬浮岛 R-02，伊莎贝拉家族的庄园、冬季宴会的举办地。，详见 docs/card-buildings.md。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 蜂蜜色石砌三层主楼，两端各一座圆塔，陡石板顶带一排老虎窗；中央一座凸出的楼梯塔楼配柱廊门廊——沃德斯登式的法国文艺复兴外观。
desc.en: A honey-stone, three-storey house with a round tower at each end and a row of dormers along the steep slate roof; a projecting stair tower with a columned porch stands at the centre, in a Waddesdon-style French-Renaissance manner.

desc.zh: 主楼与宴会厅各自的陡石板顶与铅皮四坡顶，屋脊立着一排石砌烟囱。
desc.en: Steep slate roofs over the main house and lead hips over the ballroom, with a row of stone chimney stacks along the ridge.

desc.zh: 双立方比例的宴会厅，高窗、铅皮四坡顶、屋脊三道采光窗，门廊车道在西侧，玻璃连廊接回主楼——卡里冬季宴会的举办地。
desc.en: A double-cube ballroom with tall windows, a lead hipped roof and three ridge skylights, a porte-cochère on the west side and a glazed gallery back to the house — where the card's winter ball is held.

desc.zh: 主楼北侧一座石栏台地，四块黄杨绿篱花坛种着深红叶的冬季花床，中央一方长水池。
desc.en: A balustraded terrace north of the house with four box-hedged parterres of deep-red winter bedding and a long rectangular pool at the centre.

desc.zh: 主楼南侧一圈砾石回车圆，中央一座石喷泉，车道分别通向宴会厅门廊与停靠平台。
desc.en: A gravel carriage sweep south of the house with a stone fountain at its centre, with drives leading to the ballroom porch and the docking platform.

desc.zh: 府邸东侧一片开阔草坪，外圈一带橡树与雪松林。
desc.en: An open lawn east of the house, screened by a belt of oaks and cedars.

desc.zh: 岛缘一座钢结构停靠平台，只供私人悬浮载具起降；卡说岛间只有私人悬浮载具，不画飞艇。
desc.en: A steel docking platform at the island's edge for private hover vehicles only; the card mentions only private hover transport between isles, so no airships are shown.

desc.zh: 岛缘符文环、悬浮玻璃亭与全息园灯——2088 魔导科技层的统一点缀，无文字、无徽记。
desc.en: A rune ring at the island's edge, floating glass pavilions and holographic garden lamps — the shared 2088 magitech dressing, with no text or crests.
